svg.title: DNA of nine named districts
svg.desc: Stacked bars of category shares for a financial district, a going-out district and a residential suburb in London, Amsterdam and Hiroshima.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three kinds of neighbourhood, three cities

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each bar is one H3 cell of about 0.6 km2: the share of its places by function.
